Overview

Scorpions are a very rare mob only found in the deserts of Ferwater. They mostly fall into a ravine in the desert, where you can find and catch them. They can also be disabled with the creepy crawly setting.

The only way to catch a scorpion is by using the Bug Net or the Bug Catcher 3000, which are purchasable in Flora Laura Shop. They can be sold at the Resource Hub.
